drawing_metadata.title: Engineering Profile Drawing
drawing_metadata.description: 2D profile of an irregular shape with a central slot and various radii.

geometric_features.description: The main outer boundary of the part, defined by a series of tangent radii.

elements.location_description: Mid-left inward curve of the profile.

geometric_features.description: A vertical slot feature located in the upper central portion of the profile.

elements.location_description: Radius of the two semicircular ends of the slot.
elements.note: The '2x' prefix indicates that both ends of the slot have this radius. If this defines the slot width, the width would be 2 * 0.68 = 1.36.

elements.location_description: Distance from the main vertical centerline to the rightmost vertical tangent line of the slot.
elements.note: This dimension implies a total slot width of 2 * 0.93 = 1.86. This value appears to contradict the width implied by the '2xR0.68' end radii if the slot is a standard 'pill' shape (where width = 2R). This suggests the slot has parallel straight sections with a width of 1.86, and the ends are rounded with R0.68, which is geometrically inconsistent as the radius of the ends should match half the slot width.

positioning_dimensions.location_description: Distance from a horizontal reference line (passing below the slot) to the top tangent point of the slot.

dimensional_information.location_description: Overall vertical dimension from the bottom horizontal centerline to the top horizontal line (tangent to the R30.00 curve).
Vertical dimension from the bottom horizontal centerline to a horizontal line above it (tangent to the R8.25 curve).
Vertical dimension from the bottom horizontal centerline to a horizontal line below the R4.00 feature.
Horizontal dimension from the main vertical centerline to a vertical line on the left (tangent to the R4.00 feature).

reference_elements.location_description: Main vertical axis, passing through the center of the slot and the bottommost point of the profile.
Multiple horizontal reference lines used for vertical dimensioning, including one at the bottom of the profile and one below the slot.
A cross symbol (+) on the left side of the profile, indicating a reference point or center for the R4.00 curve.
